title: Registered predictions of the conditional-coupling flow-matching studies (cocofip registrations)
description: Public, self-contained record of the pre-registered predictions of a series of studies on conditional couplings for flow matching (KR-AQCOT and its baselines) and on flows modelling Monte-Carlo simulations: prediction files, registration stamps (sha256 of the prediction file and study configuration printed by a scheduler job before the first graded run) and the held-out audit files a registration depends on. The sbibm benchmark registration (stamps A and B) was published before the study-B flows were trained. The code lives in a separate repository.
